name: Crucible-Vast
geological_features: Toxic atmospheric layers with visible chemical reactions
Massive atmospheric vortex at the south pole
Internal heat source warming the planet beyond expected levels
specific_features: Quarantine zone designation by sector authority
Radiation hotspots moving through the atmosphere in patterns
description: Crucible-Vast is a mid-sized gas giant with an atmosphere of unusual toxicity, its cloud layers a roiling mass of reactive compounds that undergo visible chemical transformations as they cycle through pressure and temperature zones. The colors shift constantly, from acidic yellow to bruised purple to an unsettling red-orange, as different chemical species dominate at different altitudes. A massive vortex at the south pole draws material from the upper atmosphere into the depths in a spiral that has persisted for at least as long as records exist.

The planet generates significantly more heat than its distance from its star would predict, suggesting an internal energy source beyond normal gravitational contraction. This excess heat drives atmospheric convection of unusual violence, with upwelling columns of gas visible as bright plumes that punch through the cloud layers before cooling and sinking back. The radiation environment is complex and variable, with hotspots that move through the atmosphere in patterns that resist meteorological explanation.

Sector authorities have designated Crucible-Vast a quarantine zone following the loss of three atmospheric probes under circumstances that suggested directed interference rather than equipment failure. The probes' telemetry showed normal function until the moment of contact loss, and the last transmissions from each included electromagnetic patterns that matched each other but no natural phenomenon. The radiation hotspots have been tracked over decades and their movement patterns, when mapped in three dimensions, describe geometric shapes of increasing complexity.

The quarantine designation has not prevented unauthorized approaches, and several ships have reported anomalous sensor readings when passing through the outer system. The planet's fuel reserves remain untapped, and the military potential of whatever is generating the radiation patterns has not been lost on sector intelligence agencies. Whether the phenomena represent a natural process, remnant technology, or something actively present remains the central question, and one that the quarantine zone makes difficult to answer.
